item.title: TP-Link TL-WR840N EU v5 PING Diagnostic Command Injection RCE (CVE-2021-41653)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2021-41653. Status: Weaponized. Affects: TP-Link TL-WR840N EU v5 router firmware, PING diagnostic web function. Tags: TP-Link, TL-WR840N, router, command-injection, ping, diagnostics, CGI, MIPS, reverse-shell, CWE-94.

item.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Boot Session Authentication Bypass to Root RCE (CVE-2026-20079)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — web · CVE-2026-20079. Status: Weaponized (full authentication-bypass to root RCE chain; requires the boot-created session to still exist). Affects: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC), on-premises. Tags: cisco, fmc, firewall-management-center, auth-bypass, CWE-288, unauthenticated, root-rce, cgi, makeself, cisa-kev.
